messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to finalize private deployment shipping decisions this quarter. Two deciders: customer-managed networking (CMN) — GA vs beta, and guaranteed upgrade path for on-prem v1 -> v2. Please chime with risks, regression criteria, and minimal launch gates.

matt: Prefer Beta for CMN. We don't yet have cross-distro NAT traversal tested; GA should wait for HSM/KMS verification.

sophie: Beta is fine if we make rollback explicit and document support boundaries. Need opt-in telemetry and clear data residency language.

raj: Upgrade path — customers want in-place zero-downtime where possible. Propose: GA promises 'rolling patch' for minor releases, major upgrades = assisted migration with snapshot/restore. That reduces blast radius.

elaine: @raj can you write the migration contract bullets by EOD? We need concrete gating criteria for QA signoff.

raj: Yup, will draft. Key items: db schema migration safe-by-default, agent backward-compat checks, auto-fallback to previous image.

matt: For CMN, ops notes: require static routes + BGP optional. If customer chooses BGP, we require an ASN and 2x redundant peers.

jo: Docs ask — add a "network mode matrix" table: what we support (NAT, static, BGP) and required permissions/ports.

sophie: Also surface the security review outcome: if CMN GA, we must have KMS integration + audit logs present. Beta can have 'limited audit retention' but must flag to customers.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] nightly-e2e/priv-deploy-tests started.

elaine: Decision proposal: ship Private Deploy GA without customer-managed networking enabled by default. Offer CMN as opt-in beta with explicit support contract. GA will include rolling minor upgrades; major upgrades are assisted. Launch gates: e2e green, 3 pilot customers signed for GA, SSO + KMS validated.

matt: +1

sophie: +1 with note to include pricing addendum for CMN support.

raj: +1, will drop migration contract PR by 5pm PST.

elaine: OK — action items: @raj migration contract, @jo network-mode matrix draft, @sophie security gating doc, @matt ops runbook for BGP peers. We'll review Wednesday 10am. :calendar:

elaine: closing thread — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
